claim_summary: BatteryLake contributes an evidence-grounded, human-governed agentic pipeline for curating heterogeneous battery time series, plus a reproducible SOH/RUL benchmark.

claim_evidence.quote: BatteryLake, a governed data lakehouse that turns raw public battery data into benchmark-ready assets through an agentic, evidence-grounded curation framework.

modules.name: Evidence-grounded metadata extraction
modules.scope_reason: R3_1 TSK does not apply because extraction has no task-family objective; R3_2 GTS does not apply because its inputs and state are source documents without temporal order, windows, units, or availability constraints; R3_3 GH applies because the provenance-ranked extraction workflow organizes model execution.

evidence.quote: prompts require a verbatim quotation for every non-⊥ value, and a post-hoc string check rejects any tuple whose quotation does not occur in the source text

modules.name: Selective human verification
modules.scope_reason: R3_1 TSK does not apply because confidence-based review is not tied to a prediction objective; R3_2 GTS does not apply because the routing criterion is confidence rather than temporal state; R3_3 GH applies because the mechanism routes uncertain decisions to a human interface and gates execution.
rubric_path: R3_2_GTS:no - confidence routing has no temporal semantics

evidence.quote: auto-accepts decisions with c ≥ τ and routes the rest to a human reviewer, who edits or confirms them through the platform interface; no row enters the lake unconfirmed.

modules.name: Canonical time-series schema and validation gate
modules.scope_reason: R3_1 TSK does not apply because the schema and gate are shared across task families; R3_2 GTS applies because the representation fixes sample ordering, units, sign conventions, and temporal consistency checks, which would remain useful if SOH/RUL were replaced by another time-series task.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:no - schema and admission checks are not prediction-objective-specific
R3_2_GTS:yes - ordered samples, units, and temporal consistency

evidence.quote: Time series T: one tuple per sample with canonical signals time_s, voltage_V, current_A, temperature_C, charge/discharge_capacity_Ah, step_type, under fixed units and the sign convention I > 0 on charge
Consistency: monotonic timestamps, contiguous cycle numbering, a single current sign convention, step-type coherence

modules.name: Validation-guided converter synthesis and repair
modules.scope_reason: R3_1 TSK does not apply because converter generation is not bound to SOH/RUL outputs; R3_2 GTS applies because conversion maps numerical temporal signals, units, and cycle structure into a canonical time-series representation and validates them; changing the downstream task need not redesign that conversion contract.
rubric_path: R3_2_GTS:yes - maps and checks temporal measurement data

evidence.quote: The validator replays Σ on the outputs and emits a machinereadable report; on failure, the error report is fed back and the agent repairs π , up to k rounds.

modules.name: SOH/RUL reproducible benchmark
modules.scope_reason: R3_1 TSK applies because the benchmark embeds SOH/RUL prediction targets, split protocols, and metrics; changing the task family requires changing these task-specific requirements, so it is a benchmark resource rather than a reusable GTS procedure.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - SOH/RUL targets and evaluation protocol define prediction tasks

evidence.quote: BatteryLake defines two primary tasks with standardized labels: SOH estimation (predict capacity retention at a cycle from partial-cycle signals or cycle-level features) and RUL prediction (predict cycles remaining to a manifest-recorded end-of-life threshold).

temporal_validity.quote: Because split design dominates apparent performance in battery ML, every experiment declares one of three protocols: random (cycles shuffled; optimistic), temporal (early cycles train, late cycles test; forecasting under distribution shift), and cross-cell (whole cells held out; generalization to unseen units).

changes: name: quote-grounded extraction and human review -> evidence-grounded metadata extraction; selective verification is a separate module
dimensions: legacy Control, Verification, and Feedback -> Planning and Orchestration; retain Memory and Context
reconciliation.reason: The packet specifies extraction and selective human verification as independently described mechanisms. The existing id remains with extraction; the review routing is recorded separately.

changes: name: canonical temporal measurement schema and validation -> canonical time-series schema and validation gate
dimensions: legacy Control, Verification, and Feedback -> Planning and Orchestration; retain Interface and Interaction
reconciliation.reason: The packet supports the canonical time-series representation and 26-rule gate; temporal order, fixed units, signal conventions, and timestamp checks meet GTS. Legacy dimensions are replaced with current vocabulary.

changes: dimensions: legacy Control, Verification, and Feedback -> Planning and Orchestration
reconciliation.reason: The SOH/RUL benchmark is a task-bound evaluation resource with standardized outputs, split protocols, and metrics; the packet provides no evidence that the benchmark itself implements a temporal processing function.

notes: The card omitted the validation-guided converter synthesis and repair mechanism and treated extraction plus selective review as one module. The packet describes benchmark protocols and metric choices but contains no reported benchmark result values, so task_performance is not marked present.
